rationale: The bug is on line 14 where a TypeError exception (raised when token is None or wrong type for compare_digest) is caught and silently ignored with 'pass'. The function then falls through to return False, making it appear the token was simply invalid rather than surfacing that a type error occurred. This is a silent_failure because the error is detected (caught) but discarded without logging, re-raising, or any error indicator. The severity is trivial because it only affects the single validation call - returning False instead of raising an exception - with no persistent effect beyond that single invocation.
